edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open.
edits.replacement: Access checks default to fail-closed. When a check fails to determine that access is allowed, access is denied.
edits.reason: Fail-closed versus fail-open is a genuine technical distinction, not ordinary-knowledge antonyms, so it is stated as its own sentence of fact instead of a tacked-on "rather than" trailer.
